features.text: Anatomically molded stays conform to your leg shape over time for personalized support
Innovative accordion-design posterior prevents material bunching during knee flexion
Adjustable and removable oval donut buttress provides customizable patella stabilization
Breathable Lycra liner with varied thickness zones ensures comfort and durability
Dual hook-and-loop straps above and below the joint deliver secure, customizable compression

measurement: For optimal therapeutic benefits and support, measure the circumference of your knee at the center of the patella. Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for detailed sizing guidance and expert fitting assistance.
